relationship_to_existing_e5.rationale: this route identifies relative effective observation distortion by externally anchoring ecological activity rather than by directly calibrating detection; it is a distinct estimand and may not be called a pass of the frozen direct-detection G4

scientific_question: when ecological diel activity is independently anchored by telemetry-derived movement, how much of the camera-trap diel pattern is attributable to effective observation distortion, and does that distortion transfer across geography and season?

identification_target.activity_curve: A_gs(t), relative diel ecological activity within geography g and season s
identification_target.camera_observation_distortion: D_gs(t), relative diel effective camera observation distortion conditional on A_gs(t)
identification_target.identification_scale: D_gs(t) is identified only up to a multiplicative constant and must be normalized within geography-season

external_activity_anchor.acceptable_measurement: movement rate derived from successive telemetry locations divided by elapsed time, or an equivalently predeclared independent activity proxy

route_gates.pass: at least two geographies each retain both camera and telemetry/activity-anchor channels
telemetry schema retains individual identity, time, and movement/activity information or coordinates sufficient for the frozen proxy
camera schema retains physical sampling identity and event time with reproducible effort/exposure path
camera and telemetry exposure overlap sufficiently across the predeclared seasonal/diel support in both geographies
the frozen joint likelihood identifies the relative diel shape of D(t) after anchoring A(t); only shape, not absolute detection or abundance, is claimed
joint model, normalization and geographic heldout test are frozen before response values are opened

claims_if_route_eventually_qualifies.maximum_claim: relative diel camera observation distortion can be estimated against an independently anchored telemetry activity profile and tested for geographic transfer
